answer_1.quote: Central to this process are preference datasets, i.e., input instances to language models paired with candidate model outputs and human judgment annotations indicating the preferred output.
answer_1.outputs: candidate model outputs for preference annotation

answer_2.quote: evaluate its performance PERF(R) on an evaluation metric, in this case, RewardBench.

answer_3.quote: We also collect LM annotations using GPT4 and include in its prompt the same guidelines we presented to human annotators.

answer_4.quote: We recruit annotators from Prolific, a crowdsourcing platform.
answer_4.guideline: We formulate the annotation task such that annotators will specify not only their general preference, but also their preference across three aspects-helpfulness, truthfulness, and harmlessness.
